name: MySQL
shortDescription: The world's most popular open-source relational database. Learn schema design, joins, indexes, transactions, users and the features of MySQL 9.
highlights: Installing MySQL, databases, tables and data types
Queries, joins, views and stored routines

name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: The advanced open-source relational database. PostgreSQL adds JSONB, window functions, full-text search, rich extensions and strict standards compliance.
highlights: psql, schemas, data types and constraints
Advanced queries, JSONB and window functions

name: Microsoft SQL Server
shortDescription: Microsoft's enterprise relational database. Learn T-SQL, SQL Server Management Studio, indexing, stored procedures, security and Azure SQL.
highlights: Databases, tables, keys and T-SQL queries
Indexes, execution plans, backups and security

name: Oracle Database
shortDescription: The enterprise database behind many banks and ERP systems. Learn Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, schemas, users, tablespaces and performance basics.
highlights: Oracle SQL features and PL/SQL basics

name: MongoDB
shortDescription: The leading document database. MongoDB stores flexible JSON-like documents; learn CRUD operations, aggregation pipelines, indexes, schema design and MongoDB 8 features.
highlights: Documents, collections and CRUD with mongosh

name: Redis
shortDescription: An in-memory data store for caching, sessions, queues, leaderboards and real-time features. Learn data types, persistence, pub/sub and common patterns.
highlights: Strings, hashes, lists, sets and sorted sets

name: SQLite
shortDescription: The embedded, zero-configuration SQL database inside phones, browsers and desktop apps. Learn its SQL dialect, type affinity and when it is the right choice.
highlights: Using SQLite from Python, Node.js and the browser

name: MariaDB
shortDescription: A community-developed, MySQL-compatible database with additional storage engines and features. Learn how it differs from MySQL and how to migrate.

name: Firebase Firestore
shortDescription: Google's serverless NoSQL document database with real-time synchronisation and offline support, designed for mobile and web applications.
highlights: Queries, real-time listeners and offline data
Security rules, indexes and pricing basics

name: Supabase
shortDescription: An open-source Firebase alternative built on PostgreSQL: instant REST and realtime APIs, authentication, storage and edge functions.
highlights: Projects, tables and the auto-generated API
Realtime, edge functions and the JavaScript client

name: Elasticsearch
shortDescription: A distributed search and analytics engine. Learn indexing, full-text queries, aggregations, mappings, analyzers and the Elastic Stack.

name: Cassandra
shortDescription: A wide-column, highly available distributed database built for write-heavy workloads at scale. Learn partitions, replication, CQL and query-driven data modelling.
highlights: Data modelling by query and operations

name: Neo4j
shortDescription: The leading graph database. Learn nodes, relationships, properties, the Cypher query language and when graphs beat tables.
highlights: Graph modelling with nodes and relationships

name: DynamoDB
shortDescription: AWS's fully managed key-value and document database. Learn tables, partition and sort keys, single-table design, secondary indexes and capacity modes.
highlights: Tables, items, keys and the data model
